# t3 (Turbo 3): Blazing-Fast S3 CLI & Drop-In `s5cmd` Successor in Rust

> `t3` (Turbo 3) is an ultra-fast, memory-safe S3 client and 100% drop-in `s5cmd` replacement written in Rust — sister project to [RustStack](https://github.com/ehlerst/ruststack). Designed to saturate 40–100 Gbps links and NVMe arrays while using a fraction of the memory of `s5cmd` and running up to 100x faster than `aws s3`.

## Quick Facts
- **Startup Time**: ~1.5 ms cold start (~15x faster than `s5cmd`, ~300x faster than `aws-cli`)
- **Idle / Small Transfer Memory**: ~4.5 MiB RSS
- **Drop-In `s5cmd` CLI Compatibility**: Supports all 15 `s5cmd` subcommands (`cp`, `mv`, `sync`, `ls`, `rm`, `run`, `cat`, `pipe`, `head`, `du`, `mb`, `rb`, `presign`, `select`, `bucket-version`, `version`) and global flags (`--numworkers`, `--endpoint-url`, `--stat`, `--json`, `--dry-run`)
- **Sister Project**: Native companion to [`RustStack`](https://github.com/ehlerst/ruststack) (`http://localhost:4566`)

## Supported Subcommands (15 Total)
1. **`cp`**: Parallel upload, pre-allocated `pwrite` range download, and server-side / multipart S3-to-S3 copy (supports objects > 5 GiB).
2. **`mv`**: High-speed parallel move (`cp` + source deletion).
3. **`sync`**: Concurrent source & destination streaming diff engine with `--delete`, `--size-only`, `--exact-timestamps`, and strict `--exclude`/`--include` filter enforcement.
4. **`ls`**: Fast bucket and prefix listing with speculative `Delimiter=/` fan-out, `--etag`, `--humanize`, `--show-fullpath`, `--all-versions`.
5. **`rm`**: Pipelined concurrent 1,000-key `DeleteObjects` batcher.
6. **`run`**: "Beast Mode" concurrent batch command execution from a file or `stdin` sharing a single connection & worker pool.
7. **`cat`**: Ordered streaming of one or more S3 objects (including wildcards) to `stdout`.
8. **`pipe`**: Bounded-memory parallel multipart streaming upload from `stdin` to S3.
9. **`head`**: `HeadBucket` and `HeadObject` metadata inspection.
10. **`du`**: Disk usage summary with `--group` by storage class and `--humanize`.
11. **`mb` & `rb`**: Bucket creation and deletion (including `rb --force`).
12. **`presign`**: Query-string SigV4 presigned `GET` URL generator.
13. **`select`**: Parallel SQL `SELECT` projection and filtering on JSON/NDJSON and CSV objects.
14. **`bucket-version`**: Get or set (`Enabled` / `Suspended`) bucket versioning.
15. **`version`**: Build and compatibility metadata.

## Usage with RustStack or AWS S3
```bash
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1

t3 --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 mb s3://my-bucket
t3 --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --stat cp ./dataset/ s3://my-bucket/dataset/
t3 --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566 --stat sync --delete ./dataset/ s3://my-bucket/dataset/
```
